name: ETL Apollo Data to Azure Synapse Analytics
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **Apollo** as the data source.
2.  Select your added **Azure Synapse Analytics** data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorise DataChannel to connect to your Apollo account with your **API Key.**
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/apollo/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
